name: BrowseComp-Plus
intro: BrowseComp-Plus 将 1,266 个 BrowseComp 问答对依次筛为 1,142、1,005 和 830 个经人工验证的查询。仅从最终 830 个查询挖掘困难负样本，并构建含 Evidence/Gold qrels 的 100,195 篇固定去重语料；端到端回答与引用评测和独立检索评测分开报告。
build_method: o3格式/拒答筛选, Selenium与Trafilatura抓取筛选, 14人超过400小时人工验证, 最终830条上的GPT-4o分解与SerpAPI困难负样本挖掘
metric: Answer Accuracy, Recall, Search Calls, Citation Precision/Recall, Evidence/Gold Recall@5/100/1000, NDCG@10
task_type: Agent任务, 开放式问答, 事实验证
eval_feature: 固定语料可复现评测, GPT-4.1端到端回答判分, 引用精确率/召回率, Evidence/Gold独立检索指标
scale: 830个验证查询, 100,195篇去重文档; 平均6.1篇Evidence、76.28篇困难负样本、2.9篇Gold/查询
drawio_review_note: REDRAW. Reviewed against arXiv:2508.06600v1 §2-§3 and official repository commit 046949032b0328319cc9a02663a759ec601d9402. The diagram locks the exact 1,266 → minus 124 formatting/abstention failures → 1,142 → Selenium/Trafilatura → minus 137 hallucinated-URL or scrape failures → 1,005 → human verification → 830 funnel. Hard negatives now originate only from the final 830 via GPT-4o subqueries and SerpAPI. End-to-end answer evaluation uses the GPT-4.1 judge and is separated from citation metrics and standalone Evidence/Gold Recall@5/100/1000 plus nDCG@10 retrieval evaluation.
task_type_en: Agent Task, Open-ended QA, Fact Verification
build_method_en: o3 formatting/abstention filtering, Selenium/Trafilatura scrape filtering, 400+ hours by 14 annotators, then GPT-4o decomposition and SerpAPI hard-negative mining on the final 830
eval_feature_en: Reproducible fixed corpus, GPT-4.1 end-to-end answer judging, citation precision/recall, and separate Evidence/Gold retrieval metrics
intro_en: BrowseComp-Plus filters 1,266 BrowseComp pairs through 1,142 and 1,005 intermediate sets to 830 human-verified queries. Hard negatives are mined only from the final 830, producing a 100,195-document fixed corpus with Evidence/Gold qrels; end-to-end answer and citation evaluation are reported separately from standalone retrieval evaluation.
